comment: Labels for the task queue (GitHub issues). docs/AGENT_ROLES.md says what each role may do. Create them with `gh label create` or the GitHub UI; tests/test_issue_templates.py checks that every label a template uses is listed here.

labels.name: role:orchestrator
labels.description: plans tasks from the roadmap and coverage.json

labels.name: role:sampler
labels.description: chooses designs and estimates their cost

labels.name: role:launcher
labels.description: the only role that starts a solver

labels.name: role:solver-adapter
labels.description: connects one solver to the record format

labels.name: role:curator
labels.description: keeps the data index and the upload staging

labels.name: role:trainer
labels.description: trains a release on passed records

labels.name: role:content
labels.description: docs, coverage map, model cards, pages

labels.name: kind:claim
labels.description: a contributor reserves design ids before solving

labels.name: status:accepted
labels.description: the maintainer accepted it; work can start

labels.name: status:needs-review
labels.description: a verdict or result needs a person to look

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: cannot go on; the issue says why
